title: A test: carbon ore gathered at Neverworld Carbon (Yildun) into storage at Ramen's Rest, Last Light (eight jumps)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-22 07:08 UTC (orders.log ENT-062, block ZERO: gather what the reserve lacks, carbon first, beyond our systems; rules F3, F23, F24, F36, F37). The reserve is short of 84,819 carbon ore (surplus.py reserve, 07:03 UTC), the near fields read empty; Neverworld Carbon is a carbon-only belt, 13,593 of 30,000 at richness 23 (table fields, read 2.3 h before 07:05 UTC). Ramen's Rest (Last Light, a station with storage) is the nearest storage, eight jumps by Avior, Hawthorne, Alchiba, Pinecross, Brightfall, Errai and Fang; no pirate line on that road or in Yildun in 24 hours (data/intel/sightings.jsonl, 07:08 UTC). Yildun is the north choke of orders P3. One ship, hold empty, three results before a lift (F3, F37); stores everything, sells nothing (F24). 15:10 UTC (Zero, orders ENT-064 block ZERO: loads go to the receivers by gift; requests ENT-350, ENT-351): gift to the hauler Apollo named at this station (data/fleet/receivers.json): with strict classes on each run docks, stores and gives the reserve's ores of its hold and of the pilot's storage there to Logistics, which crafts them where they lie. Three results (F37): 286, 310 and 390 carbon in 150 to 161 minutes, -900 to -1,100 cr a run, by two ships, no stranger in the notes; the field read 14,406 at about 13:20 UTC: max_ships 1 -> 4 (about 500 carbon an hour, under 30 hours of the field above min_left). 2026-11-22 19:20 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 4 -> 6.
